glosses: (für bestimmte Zeit) gegen Empfindungen, insbesondere Schmerz, teilweise oder vollständig unempfindlich machen; taub machen

examples.text: Der Zahnarzt betäubt das Zahnfleisch, bevor er operiert.
„Er ist nicht etwa gestillt, sondern er ist betäubt, so wie bei Abmagerungskuren der physische Hunger statt mit Brot mit magenberuhigenden AntiHungerPillen betäubt wird.“

translations.source_sense_description: de pijnprikkel onderdrukken, bijvoorbeeld door het toedienen van een medicijn

glosses: einen (sehr) unangenehmen Zustand, oft von Schmerzen oder Not, (ein wenig) zum Besseren hin verändern

examples.text: Wärme lindert Schmerz.
„Spendenaktionen setzen ein, Sammlungen lindern Elend und Not, Militär und Feuerwehren greifen ein.“
Bei Husten kann man einen lindernden Kräutertee geben.
„Sie haben wohl davon gehört, wie er 1997 die Folgen der großen Oderflut linderte, wie er sich einen Namen als Krisenmanager machte und bald von vielen ‚Der Deichgraf’ genannt wurde.“
[Covid-19-Erkrankungen:] „Bei einer Notoperation musste ihr ein Teil des Schädels entfernt werden, um den Druck auf ihr geschwollenes Gehirn zu lindern.“

translations.source_sense_description: de pijnprikkel onderdrukken, bijvoorbeeld door het toedienen van een medicijn

glosses: Physically unable to feel, not having the power of sensation.

examples.text: fingers numb with cold
legs numb from kneeling

glosses: Emotionally unable to feel or respond in a normal way.

examples.text: numb with shock; numb with boredom

[…] when we know that hundreds are rendered homeless every day, and countless thousands are killed and wounded, men and boys mowed down like a field of grain, and with as little compunction, we grow a little bit numb to human misery.
[…] seeing the dog—somehow that made me feel again. I’d been too dazed, too numb, to feel the full viciousness of it.
[…] he submitted […] as a traitor, his mind numb with vodka, submits to a firing squad.

glosses: Dumb or stupid.
Causing numbness.

examples.text:
[…] he did lap me
Even in his own garments, and gave himself,
All thin and naked to the numb cold night.

glosses: To cause to become numb (physically or emotionally).

examples.text: The dentist gave me novocaine to numb my tooth before drilling, thank goodness.
When I first heard the news, I was numbed by the shock.

The ravviſh danke of clumzie vvinter ramps / The fluent ſummers vaine: and drizling ſleete / Chilleth the vvan bleak cheek of the numd earth, / VVhilſt ſnarling guſts nibble the iuyceles leaues, / From the nak't ſhuddring branch; […]
But her main concern is the hard seating that numbs the nether regions.

glosses: To cause (a feeling) to be less intense.

examples.text: He turned to alcohol to numb his pain.
[I was] thankful for the pain, which helped to numb my terror.

glosses: To cause (the mind, faculties, etc.) to be less acute.

examples.text: […] hunger, fatigue, and despairing hopelessness had numbed his brain […]
The noise, the rush of air past our ears, was positively terrific. It actually seemed to numb the senses and make it almost impossible to take in impressions at all.
[The sofa] exhaled a breath of trapped ancient farts, barf-smell, and antiseptic, the parfum de asylum that gradually numbed my nose to all other scents on the ward.

glosses: To become numb (especially physically).

examples.text: […] after fumbling with numbing fingers for ten or fifteen minutes, he waved his hand with a gesture of despair […]
[…] once more his feet began to numb. Again he got down and stamped the circulation going, but as soon as he began to ride again they numbed.

glosses: To administer anesthesia to: to render unfeeling or unconscious through the use of narcotic substances, usually either alcohol or pharmaceutical drugs.

examples.text: Just prior to surgery the doctor will anesthetize him and he will sleep for four hours.

glosses: Suspender o eliminar la sensibilidad de todo el cuerpo o de una parte de él, generalmente por medio de la anestesia (alguna droga que prive de la sensibilidad al dolor).
Eliminar o suspender temporalmente la sensibilidad emocional por algún choque, por alguna distracción, o como mecanismo de defensa.

examples.text: En el coche me anestesié con la radio a todo volumen, una emisora cualquiera en la que sonaba Bob Marley
